out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sinks (nos./capacities)
violations.observation: There is not an adequate number of handwashing sinks lavatories on site. HAMEND-2025-00183 HAS BEEN APPROVED BY THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT (PLBC-2025-01543); FACILITY HAS A CONTRACTOR SCHEDULED TO INSTALL THE HANDWASHING SINK ON 3/11/2026.
violations.corrective_action: At least one hand washing sink, a number of hand washing sinks necessary for their convenient use by employees in areas specified under 5-204.11 and not fewer than the number of hand washing sinks required by Law shall be provided. PLEASE PROVIDE EHS WITH PROOF OF THE HANDWASHING SINK INSTALLED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed the pre-wash spray hose to extend below the flood rim level of the sink basin at the 3-vat sink. OBSERVED PRE-SCRAPE PASS THE FLOOD- LEVEL RIM.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by providing an air gap as specified under 5-202.13. The spray hose at the 3-vat sink shall be altered to hang above the flood level rim of the 3-vat sink in order to provide an air gap. FACILITY HAS BEEN. HANGING UP PRE-SCRAPE HOSE AT THE THREE-VAT SINK. FACILITY WILL REQUEST PLUMBER THAT IS COMING ON 3/11/26 TO REPLACE PRE- SCRAPE HOSE WITH A NEW FAUCET. PLEASE PROVIDE THE EHS WITH A PICTURE OF THE FAUCET INSTALLED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. CFM WAS UNABLE TO PROVIDE CERTIFICATION DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PLEASE ENSURE A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATION CANBE PROVIDED BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sinks (nos./capacities)
violations.observation: There is not an adequate number of handwashing sinks lavatories on site. NO HANDWASHING SINK OBSERVED IN KITCHEN (ONLY THREE VAT SINK). ESTABLISHMENT IS SERVING SNACKS THAT ARE NOT PROPORTIONED AND PREPARING VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS (SUCH AS BREAD AND CREAM CHEESE).
violations.corrective_action: At least one hand washing sink, a number of hand washing sinks necessary for their convenient use by employees in areas specified under 5-204.11 and not fewer than the number of hand washing sinks required by Law shall be provided. EHS DISCUSSED THE FACILITY’S OPTIONS WITH PIC. PLEASE ENSURE A DECISION FOR HANDWASHING SINK/FOOD SERVICE PROCESSES IS MADE BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED MULTIPLE PACKAGES OF SLICED CHEESES AT 49-51F, AND MILK AT 50F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. ALL FOOD ITEMS WERE DISCARDED AT TIME OF INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS THIS COOLER SHOULD NOT BE USED FOR TCS FOODS UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED 1-DOOR FRIGIDAIRE AT 48F; THE COOLER IS NON-NSF APPROVED AND RESIDENTIAL.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED TCS FOODS OUT OF TEMPERATURE. COOLER IS NOT NSF-APPROVED; EHS WILL CONTACT PIC REGARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR EITHER REPAIRING OR REPLACING COOLER. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED THREE-VAT SINK (USED FOR HANDWASHING AS WELL) UNABLE TO PROVIDE CONTINUOUS RUNNING WATER (HANDLE ON PRE-SCRAPE HOSE MUST BE USED FOR WATER TO RUN).
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PIC UNDERSTANDS WATER FROM THE THREE-VAT SINK MUST BE CONTINUOUS RUNNING WATER. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP.
